column3: With respect to the Aura Hotel Times Square Mortgage Loan (4.3%), the Mortgaged Property was converted to an independent, unflagged hotel use in 2007 then known as Hotel Mela Times Square. The Mortgaged Property was secured by a prior loan that was securitized in CD 2017-CD6 and delinquent multiple times between mid-2020 and 2021 as a result of COVID-related cash flow disruptions. To improve cash flow, the owners entered into two contracts with New York City and the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (from May 2020 to June 2021 and from December 2022 to April 2024) to operate as a migrant shelter under the New York City Sanctuary Hotel Program. A capital improvements program was undertaken in 2023-2024 totaling approximately $6.2 million. The renovations included upgrading all 234 rooms with new case goods, soft seating, bedding, rugs, bathroom floors and tubs, and improving the lobby and corridors with furniture and carpet replacements and new painting and millwork. The Aura Hotel Times Square Property reopened as the rebranded Aura Hotel Times Square in June 2024. The Aura Hotel Times Square Mortgage Loan is a refinancing of a prior mortgage loan that was modified and extended following payment delinquencies, subject to certain conditions, including the capital improvements program funded from borrower equity and remaining FF&E reserves. The prior mortgage loan was transferred to special servicing in June 2023 due to imminent default and ultimately returned from the special servicer as a corrected mortgage loan in January 2024.
